diagnosis.summary: Both payment-service and order-service are experiencing severe failures. Payment-service is returning 5xx errors on 99.37% of requests with p95 latency up from 4.5 ms to 1968 ms. Order-service is returning 5xx errors on 57.45% of requests, with 158 dependency errors per minute against payment-service and p95 latency up from 25.1 ms to 2742 ms.
diagnosis.root_cause: A traffic surge to payment-service and a payment-service handler fault, active at the same time, are the most likely root cause.
evidence: Payment-service 5xx error rate is at 99.37% against a baseline of 0, indicating nearly all payment requests are failing.
Payment-service p95 latency rose from 4.5 ms to 1968 ms, approximately a 437x increase.
Payment-service request rate rose from 0.94 rps to 2.65 rps, approximately a 2.81x increase above baseline.
Order-service recorded 158 dependency errors per minute against payment-service (baseline 0), with the p95 dependency call latency rising from 22.1 ms to 2429.9 ms, approximately a 110x increase.
Order-service 5xx error rate reached 57.45% (baseline 0) and p95 latency rose from 25.1 ms to 2742 ms, approximately a 109x increase.
Order-service mean Lambda duration rose from 2.9 ms to 635.7 ms (approximately 219x); payment-service mean Lambda duration rose from 0.59 ms to 1.93 ms (approximately 3.3x).
recommended_actions: Examine payment-service Lambda logs and error details immediately to identify what is producing the 99.37% 5xx rate, as this is the highest-impact fault and is affecting order-service downstream.
Check payment-service Lambda concurrency and throttle counts to determine whether invocations are being throttled given the request rate has risen to 2.65 rps.
Apply or tighten API Gateway rate and burst limits on the stage receiving payment-service traffic to protect the function while the handler fault is being resolved.
After payment-service is stabilised, recheck order-service error rate and dependency error count to confirm whether order-service recovers on its own.
Review order-service Lambda concurrency and logs independently to confirm no additional fault is active once the payment-service issue is resolved.
